description: This file implements the Hopcroft–Karp algorithm for maximum bipartite graph matching, including functions for finding disjoint augmenting paths and creating guide layers.

classes.name: BipartiteGraph
classes.description: Represents a bipartite graph with methods for maximum matching.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the graph.

classes.name: EdgeSet
classes.description: A set of edges with set operations.

methods.name: LargestMatching
methods.description: Computes the maximum bipartite matching using Hopcroft–Karp algorithm.

methods.name: maximalDisjointSLAPCollection
methods.description: Finds a collection of disjoint shortest augmenting paths.

methods.name: findDisjointSLAP
methods.description: Finds a disjoint shortest augmenting path starting from a node.

methods.name: findDisjointSLAPHelper
methods.description: Recursive helper for finding disjoint shortest augmenting paths.

methods.name: createSLAPGuideLayers
methods.description: Creates guide layers for the BFS in Hopcroft–Karp.
